references.observed: Actually inspected daylight wide oblique. Pale observation shaft with open tapering buttress slots near its lower and upper ends; dark circular pod,slender central red/white mast; broad bent/V-shaped hotel slab in front with white horizontal floor bands and blue/bronze window ribbons;low casino/podium and roof surfaces. Outer hotel end walls are pale solid vertical strips. Wider casino and roof-pool context must be reconciled with the retained map parts rather than omitted.

Actually inspected independent tower oblique. Three pale tapering buttresses enclose tall base openings and fan out again below the pod. Lower pod cone has an open-looking diagonal lattice over a dark core; upper pod is a wide dark glazed inverted cone with horizontal rings,terraces and roof structures. A tall red/white lattice mast rises above. Lower circular entrance drum has blue glass. Adjacent hotel wing has regular white floor stripes,dark glazing and a pale end wall. Historical branding/ride states in this photo are not a current operating-state certificate.

Actually inspected independent whole-complex night oblique:entire bent hotel slab,curved casino frontage,pool-wing roof and free-form swimming pool,circular tower entry drum,three tapering supports,pod lattice and mast. Lighting/older ride branding is not copied as a current operating-state claim.
